summary: Sardine, a live club-mixing firmware with four fixed layers (lead, chord, bass and drums) that starts every session with a newly generated groove in one of twenty styles. You play it like a DJ: drop changes in on the bar, break down, and blend into the next style.
features: Twenty club styles; a fresh groove on every start
STYLE MIX blends into another style, keeping bass or kick
Pattern modifiers incl. FAST, SLOW, REV, EUCLID; changes wait for the bar
Two-part tunes with EVOLVE; held moves like BREAK, SWEEP, TAPE STOP
145 synth sounds and 24 synthesised drum kits; no samples, no cymbals
USB MIDI out per layer with CCs; MIDI clock out or in over USB or TRS
